Package com.rays.ctl

Class UserCtl

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.rays.common.BaseCtl<UserForm,​UserDTO,​UserServiceInt>
      • com.rays.ctl.UserCtl
  • @RestController
@RequestMapping("User")
public class UserCtl
extends BaseCtl<UserForm,​UserDTO,​UserServiceInt>
    UserCtl is a REST controller for handling User-related operations. It extends BaseCtl to inherit common CRUD functionalities. Additionally, it provides APIs for: - Role preload - Profile update - Change password - Profile picture upload & download
    Author:
    Lucky Tomar
